decisions.boundary: Public interface and screenshot inspected without login, wallet or gameplay transactions. FAQ click did not expose reviewable text. No complete game, randomness or treasury audit; publication date unknown.

decisions.title: Insert Coin Labs-linked Rabbit Royale: current product and roadmap
decisions.summary: Public homepage offers a free AI demo and auto islands, while duel and infinite modes are marked coming soon. It advertises a creator share of pots and Solana VRF randomness. These are product-interface claims; payouts, fairness and launch status not independently verified.
decisions.boundary: Complete available homepage text read without wallet connection or paid gameplay. Historical pitch links this product; current ownership and contract execution not independently established. Publication date unknown.
